layout.hierarchy: Red title is the largest text. The right-hand Transformer panel is the dominant visual (largest area, most color). Attention is steered by the bright yellow highlight band, the yellow connector line, the red dashed arrow, and the red WE ARE HERE pin. The left and middle flowcharts are secondary reference diagrams. Smallest elements are the ~9-10pt block labels inside diagrams.

visual_elements.description: LEFT PANEL — 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention'. Header in red bold italic on two lines: 'Scaled Dot-Product' / 'Attention'. Below it a vertical green-stroked rectangle containing a bottom-to-top flowchart: bottom row of three circles Q (red), K (blue), V (blue); black arrows upward — Q and K feed a lavender box 'MatMul'; chain continues up through lavender box 'Scale', pink box 'Mask (opt.)', pale-green box 'SoftMax', then a second lavender box 'MatMul'; V's arrow runs up the right side as a bypass line into the top 'MatMul'; a final black arrow exits through the top of the green frame.

MIDDLE PANEL — 'Multi-Head Attention'. Header in red bold italic. Green-stroked rectangle (tiny green/white square handles visible at its corners — selection-handle artifact). Bottom-to-top: circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); each feeds one of three side-by-side white 'Linear' boxes, each with gray stacked offset copies behind it (suggesting h parallel heads); arrows converge into a wide pink box 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' (also with stacked copies), with a small italic label 'h' and a tiny pointer/brace at its right edge; arrow up to yellow box 'Concat'; arrow up to white box 'Linear'; black arrow exits through the top of the green frame.

RIGHT PANEL — full Transformer architecture inside a green-stroked rectangle split into two vertical panels: LEFT panel peach fill labeled 'Encoder' (red bold italic, top-left); RIGHT panel light-green fill labeled 'Decoder' (green bold italic, top-right). Encoder stack bottom-to-top: thick red up-arrow + black label 'Inputs'; orange box 'Input Embedding' [partly under highlight]; box 'Positional Encoding' (under yellow highlight); thin black up-arrow; orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' with three small circles at its lower edge V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); gray box 'Add & Norm'; gray box 'Feed Forward'; gray box 'Add & Norm'. Decoder stack bottom-to-top: black label 'Outputs' with '(shifted right)' beneath; orange box 'Output Embedding' [partly obscured]; box 'Positional Encoding' (under yellow highlight); black up-arrow; orange box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles; gray 'Add & Norm'; orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles; gray 'Add & Norm'; gray 'Feed Forward'; gray 'Add & Norm'; white box 'Linear'; white box 'Softmax'; thick red up-arrow into yellow box 'Output Probabilities' at the very top. A red DASHED curved arrow arcs from the top of the encoder/output area (near x 73%, y 21%) rightward and downward, arrowhead landing on the decoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' block (encoder-output → cross-attention). A small tan circle labeled 'N×' sits right of the decoder stack (~x 86%, y 55%) indicating block repetition. Two small black circular-arrow (clock-like) doodles sit on the yellow band above each 'Positional Encoding' box.

Translucent yellow rounded-rectangle band across the bottom of BOTH encoder and decoder panels (x ~55-90%, y ~72-86%), covering the two 'Positional Encoding' boxes and the Input/Output Embedding boxes; plus a yellow polyline/connector traced from the encoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' output up, right, and down into the V/K inputs of the decoder's 'Multi-Head Attention'.

Red dashed curved arrow (encoder→decoder attention connection) as described in the right panel; additionally two thick solid red up-arrows: one at 'Inputs' (bottom of encoder) and one between 'Softmax' and 'Output Probabilities' (top of decoder). All other inter-block connectors are thin solid black up-arrows.
